fluff.overview: Clan Jade Falcon has employed specialist Watch units to control the civilian population of its Occupation Zone since the earliest days of the conquest, dating back to the brutal suppression known as the Culling. As the front line of Jade Falcon repression, the police show little interest in restraint or building goodwill among the occupied Lyran population. Mounted in fast wheeled vehicles and armed with a mixture of Avenger close-combat shotguns and tranquilizer guns, they swoop in to put down riots and disturbances as soon as they occur. More ominously, the police have been involved in countless nighttime arrests of Lyran nationalists over the past two decades. Inner Sphere observers have compared these operations to Capellan-style disappearances, though the Falcon police rarely make any attempt at secrecy, and the prisoners are usually publicly punished and executed.
